outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS. THE RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND SEVERE-WIND GUSTS WILL LIKELY MAXIMIZE OVER THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON INTO THE EVENING. THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE OF ISOLATED POCKETS OF WIND DAMAGE ARE FORECAST OVER THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY AND CENTRAL GULF COAST.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: SHORTWAVE TROUGH CURRENTLY MOVING THROUGH SRN CA WILL QUICKLY EJECT NEWD THROUGH THE FOUR CORNERS AND INTO THE CNTRL PLAINS ON MONDAY. SWLY FLOW ALOFT WILL SPREAD EWD AHEAD OF THIS SHORTWAVE...HELPING TO ADVECT STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES INTO THE NRN/CNTRL PLAINS. ADDITIONALLY...THIS SWLY FLOW ALOFT WILL FOSTER LEE TROUGHING WITH SURFACE CYCLOGENESIS EVENTUALLY OCCURRING ACROSS BOTH SE CO AND SE MT. ELSEWHERE...WEAK UPPER LOW RESPONSIBLE FOR THE CONVECTION ONGOING ACROSS TX IS EXPECTED TO SLOWLY DRIFT EWD INTO THE SOUTHEAST AND A STRONG SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL ROTATE THROUGH THE NORTHEAST STATES.

sections.title: GREAT PLAINS
sections.text: COMBINATION OF A DEEPENING LEE TROUGH AND HEIGHT FALLS ASSOCIATED WITH THE APPROACHING SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL RESULT IN AT LEAST MODEST MASS RESPONSE ACROSS THE PLAINS DURING THE DAY WITH EARLY AFTERNOON DEWPOINTS LIKELY REMAINING AROUND 60 ACROSS THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS AND THE MID 50S FARTHER N. SOME HIGH LEVEL CLOUDS ARE EXPECTED BUT GIVEN THE STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...DECENT LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE AND UPSLOPE FLOW...THE AIRMASS IS EXPECTED TO BE AT LEAST MODERATELY UNSTABLE BY EARLY AFTERNOON WITH LITTLE TO NO CONVECTIVE INHIBITION. AS A RESULT...CONVECTIVE INITIATION IS EXPECTED ACROSS THE NRN AND CNTRL HIGH PLAINS BY THE EARLY AFTERNOON. 0-6 KM VERTICAL SHEAR AROUND 40 TO 50 KT IS ANTICIPATED AND WILL BE SUPPORTIVE OF A SUPERCELL MODE WITH THE INITIAL DEVELOPMENT. ALL SEVERE HAZARDS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THIS INITIAL DEVELOPMENT...INCLUDING VERY LARGE HAIL AND A FEW TORNADOES. LOCAL MAXIMUM IN THE TORNADO THREAT WILL LIKELY EXIST FROM THE DENVER METRO AREA EWD INTO THE ADJACENT PLAINS WHERE BACKED SURFACE-WINDS AND LOCALIZED ENHANCEMENT OF VORTICITY /DUE TO DENVER CYCLONE/ ARE ANTICIPATED. ANOTHER LOCAL MAX IN TORNADO THREAT MAY ALSO EXIST NEAR A SURFACE LOW IN ERN MT. VEER-BACK

sections.title: LWR PORTIONS OF MID MO VALLEY
sections.text: SCATTERED TSTMS ARE POSSIBLE DURING THE AFTERNOON ALONG A WEAK FRONT EXTENDING ACROSS THE REGION. VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE WEAK BUT MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY MAY SUPPORT A FEW UPDRAFTS CAPABLE OF HAIL AND/OR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS.

sections.title: SOUTHEAST
sections.text: WIDESPREAD TSTMS ARE EXPECTED DURING THE AFTERNOON ACROSS PORTIONS OF LA...MS...AND AL AS A WEAK UPPER LOW MOVES THROUGH. VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE WEAK AND STORM ORGANIZATION IS NOT ANTICIPATED BUT WATER LOADING IN THE STRONGEST UPDRAFTS MAY RESULT IN SOME DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...PARTICULARLY IN AREAS WHERE BREAKS IN CLOUD COVER ALLOW FOR SURFACE HEATING AND STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. ..MOSIER/GLEASON.. 06/13/2016

sections.title: EASTERN CO
sections.text: WATER VAPOR LOOP SHOWS A HIGH-AMPLITUDE UPPER TROUGH OVER CA/NV. THIS FEATURE IS FORECAST TO MOVE EASTWARD TODAY...YIELDING MID LEVEL HEIGHT-FALLS AND INCREASING WINDS ALOFT OVER THE ROCKIES AND HIGH PLAINS. MEANWHILE...INCREASING LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT AND SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY WILL RESULT IN A CORRIDOR OF STRONG/SEVERE STORMS FROM NORTHEAST NM INTO SOUTHEAST MT. THE PRIMARY FORECAST PROBLEM THIS MORNING INVOLVES A LONG-LIVED MCS THAT IS BUILDING SOUTH-SOUTHEASTWARD OVER OK. THIS MCS HAS MODIFIED/STABILIZED THE AIR MASS OVER PARTS OF EASTERN CO/WESTERN KS AND WILL HAMPER THE RETURN OF RICH MOISTURE BACK INTO THE AREA. FOR THIS REASON...HAVE ADJUSTED THE HIGHER SEVERE PROBABILITIES SOUTHWARD AND FOCUSED THE AREA OF GREATEST CONCERN TO PRIMARILY EASTERN CO. PRESENT INDICATIONS ARE THAT STORMS WILL DEVELOP OVER THE FOOTHILLS OF CENTRAL CO BY MID AFTERNOON...AND MOVE/DEVELOP EASTWARD THROUGH THE AFTERNOON AND EVENING ALONG AND TO THE SOUTH OF THE DCVZ. VERY STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND INCREASING DEEP LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR SUGGEST THAT SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE...ALONG WITH BOWING SEGMENTS PRODUCING DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. sections.title: WY/MT
sections.text: FARTHER NORTH...SCATTERED STRONG-SEVERE STORMS ARE ALSO EXPECTED TO FORM OVER PARTS OF EASTERN WY/MT. SUPERCELLS AND BOWING STORM STRUCTURES ARE EXPECTED IN THIS REGION...POSING A RISK OF VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. IF DISCRETE MODE CAN BE MAINTAINED...FORECAST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST THE RISK OF ISOLATED TORNADOES AS WELL.

SHEAR PARAMETERS ARE WEAK...BUT HIGH PWAT VALUES AND MODERATE CAPE SUGGEST A RISK OF WATER-LOADED DOWNDRAFTS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS. ..HART/LEITMAN.. 06/13/2016

sections.text: OUTFLOW RELATED TO A SOUTHWARD-MOVING MCS ACROSS SOUTHWEST OK/WESTERN NORTH TX HAS EFFECTIVELY AUGMENTED THE SYNOPTIC BOUNDARY ACROSS THE SOUTH-CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS...WITH SOME LINGERING CLOUD COVER AND AROUND 60F SURFACE DEWPOINTS EXTENDING AS FAR NORTH AS THE ARKANSAS RIVER VALLEY IN CO AT MIDDAY. ISOLATED LIGHTNING-PRODUCING CONVECTION IS ALREADY ONGOING RELATIVELY EARLY TODAY OVER THE UT/CO MOUNTAINS IN ADVANCE OF A SOUTHWEST STATES SHORTWAVE TROUGH THAT WILL GRADUALLY ACCELERATE NORTHEASTWARD TOWARD THE REGION. AS STRONGER FORCING FOR ASCENT APPROACHES THE REGION...A LIKELY INCREASE IN THUNDERSTORMS WILL OCCUR OVER THE FRONT RANGE THROUGH EARLY AFTERNOON. LOW CLOUDS ACROSS THE CO/NORTHEAST NM HIGH PLAINS SHOULD GRADUALLY ERODE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON....WITH STORMS SUBSEQUENTLY SPREADING EASTWARD ACROSS THE CO PLAINS/NORTHEAST NM TOWARD WESTERN KS AND THE TX/OK PANHANDLES THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. sections.title: HIGH PLAINS AREA
sections.text: HAVE MADE A FEW ADJUSTMENTS TO CURRENT OUTLOOK. HAVE TRIMMED BACK ON NERN PART OF THE ENHANCED AREA...AND FOCUSED FARTHER SOUTHWEST ACROSS ERN AND SERN CO INTO SWRN KS WHERE THE SHEAR-INSTABILITY PARAMETER SPACE IS MORE CONDUCIVE TO SEVERE STORMS. VERTICAL WIND PROFILES ARE SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELLS AS STORMS MOVE OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN INTO THE HIGH PLAINS. SOME UPSCALE GROWTH IS LIKELY WITH SOME OF THE STORMS...AND ACTIVITY WILL LIKELY CONTINUE INTO THE CNTRL PLAINS THIS EVENING SUPPORTED BY A STRENGTHENING LLJ. OTHERWISE HAVE INTRODUCED A MARGINAL RISK OVER NCNTRL TX FOR A LINE OF STORMS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING MARGINALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS AS THEY CONTINUE SEWD INTO EARLY EVENING. ..DIAL.. 06/13/2016 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1130 AM CDT MON JUN 13 2016/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY INCREASE IN COVERAGE/INTENSITY ACROSS THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS VICINITY THIS AFTERNOON. WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED WITHIN THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR IMAGERY SHOWS A BAND OF STORMS MOVING ACROSS THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF THE FRONT RANGE AND INTO THE PLAINS ATTM...THOUGH SOME DECREASE IN CONVECTIVE INTENSITY IS NOTED PER LATEST RADAR IMAGERY. WITH VISIBLE SATELLITE STILL SHOWING REMNANTS OF AN ERODING LOW-CLOUD DECK E OF THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND OBS REVEALING TEMPERATURES GENERALLY IN THE LOW 70S...CAPE REMAINS SUB-OPTIMAL FOR SEVERE RISK ATTM. WITH THAT SAID...LARGE-SCALE ASCENT CONTINUES TO SPREAD ACROSS WRN CO/NWRN NM AS THE UPPER TROUGH -- CENTERED OVER UT/AZ -- ADVANCES. WITH ADDITIONAL AFTERNOON HEATING OVER THE HIGH PLAINS GRADUALLY YIELDING MODERATE DESTABILIZATION...EXPECT ADDITIONAL BANDS OF CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT TO OCCUR...SPREADING ENEWD OUT OF THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. BACKGROUND SHEAR -- THOUGH MODEST ATTM -- WILL ALSO SLOWLY IMPROVE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON...AS ENHANCED MID-LEVEL SWLY FLOW /40 TO 60 KT/ SPREADS ATOP PERSISTENT SELYS AT THE SURFACE. WHILE STORM MODE REMAINS UNCERTAIN...ROTATION IS ANTICIPATED WITH ANY CELLULAR CONVECTION -- ALONG WITH ATTENDANT RISK FOR HAIL/WIND AND SOME TORNADO POTENTIAL. UPSCALE GROWTH INTO LINE SEGMENTS ALSO SEEMS LIKELY TO OCCUR WITH TIME...WITH ASSOCIATED DAMAGING WIND RISK SPREADING ACROSS ERN CO TOWARD THE NEB PANHANDLE/WRN KS/THE TX AND OK PANHANDLES LATER THIS AFTERNOON. WE WILL CONTINUE TO MONITOR DESTABILIZATION OF THE HIGH-PLAINS AIRMASS AND ASSOCIATED CU FIELD EVOLUTION...WITH AN EYE TOWARD WW ISSUANCE ROUGHLY ANTICIPATED IN THE EARLY AFTERNOON TIME FRAME.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTM COVERAGE SHOULD INCREASE THROUGH THE EARLY AFTERNOON ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS OF ERN/NRN WY AND SERN MT...WITH THREATS OF DMGG WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL EVENTUALLY EXPECTED TO DEVELOP. A TORNADO IS ALSO POSSIBLE. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE WATCH ISSUANCE IN THE NEXT COUPLE HRS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A BAND OF ASCENT PRECEDING AN ERN GREAT BASIN VORT MAX IS OVERSPREADING CNTRL WY...SUPPORTING THE DEVELOPMENT OF SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS THIS MORNING. AN AXIS OF MID-UPPER 50S F DEWPOINTS IS CENTERED FROM SWRN SD INTO ERN MT TO THE E OF A SFC TROUGH LOCATED ROUGHLY FROM KBIL SWD TO NEAR KLAR. ONGOING THUNDERSTORMS ARE LIKELY TO PERSIST THROUGH THE EARLY AFTERNOON AND ENCOUNTER A HEATING/DESTABILIZING AIR MASS ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS OF NRN/ERN WY...WHERE MLCAPE VALUES ARE CURRENTLY ESTIMATED AT 1000-1500 J/KG PER RAP-BASED MESOANALYSIS DATA. A FEW SUPERCELLS AND/OR ORGANIZED CLUSTERS ARE EXPECTED TO EVOLVE BY MID-AFTERNOON...FEATURING THE POTENTIAL FOR LARGE HAIL AND STRONG TO DMGG WIND GUSTS GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF STEEP LOW-MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND 30-40 KT OF EFFECTIVE SHEAR. ALTHOUGH LOW-LEVEL SHEAR IS RELATIVELY WEAKER...A TORNADO OR TWO MAY STILL BE POSSIBLE IN ASSOCIATION WITH ANY LONGER-LIVED SUPERCELL...PARTICULARLY INVOF MORE BACKED/SELY SFC WINDS ACROSS FAR SERN MT. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY INCREASE OVER THE NEXT COUPLE HRS...AND WILL BE MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE WATCH ISSUANCE ACROSS ERN WY AND FAR SERN MT OVER THE NEXT COUPLE HRS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED THREAT FOR SVR HAIL/WIND MAY ACCOMPANY DEVELOPING TSTMS ACROSS NERN MT INTO NWRN ND THIS AFTERNOON. IT IS UNCERTAIN WHETHER COVERAGE OF THESE THREATS WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR AREAL EXPANSION OF WATCH 249 OR ISSUANCE A NEW WW...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT SATELLITE/RADAR TRENDS SHOW AN INCREASE IN RECENT TSTM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS FAR NERN MT...EVOLVING OUT OF REMNANTS OF EARLIER CONVECTION FROM E-CNTRL MT. THIS ACTIVITY IS OCCURRING ALONG THE NRN FRINGE OF RELATIVELY RICHER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE...WITH INFLOW AIR CHARACTERIZED BY MID-UPPER 50S F DEWPOINTS OVER E-CNTRL MT. ADDITIONAL CONVECTION DEVELOPING OVER THE HIGH TERRAIN OF N-CNTRL MT MAY CONTINUE STRENGTHENING THIS AFTERNOON WITH EWD PROGRESSION INTO NERN MT AS IT ENTERS A MORE FAVORABLE AIR MASS. STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES COUPLED WITH MODERATELY STRONG MID-UPPER LEVEL FLOW WILL SUPPORT THE POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED LARGE HAIL ACCOMPANYING ANY ORGANIZED TSTM THAT CAN DEVELOP. ISOLATED STRONG TO DMGG WIND GUSTS WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE. THE RELATIVELY NARROW LONGITUDINAL EXTENT OF RICHER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE SHOULD LIMIT THE POTENTIAL FOR STRONGER CONVECTION TO WRN PORTIONS OF ND. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR INCREASING COVERAGE OF ANY POTENTIAL SVR THREAT...FOR POSSIBLE AREAL EXPANSION OF SVR TSTM WATCH 249 OR ISSUANCE OF A NEW WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR SVR WIND GUSTS AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL CONTINUES ACROSS SERN MT AND FAR ERN WY...AND WILL EVENTUALLY SPREAD INTO WRN SD AND WRN NEB 21-23Z. THE POTENTIAL FOR A TORNADO ALSO REMAINS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTMS HAVE EVOLVED INTO A LINE ACROSS NERN WY AND ARE POSING A SHORT-TERM THREAT PRIMARILY FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS. THIS LINE WILL REMAIN WITHIN THE CORRIDOR OF STRONGEST INSTABILITY INTO FAR WRN SD...BEFORE APPROACHING A DRIER AIR MASS IN PLACE OVER THE CNTRL DAKOTAS. OTHER ISOLATED SUPERCELLS/CLUSTERS HAVE DEVELOPED ACROSS S-CNTRL MT...WITH THE MOST NOTABLE OVER YELLOWSTONE COUNTY AND WILL LIKELY ENTER BIG HORN COUNTY IN THE NEXT HR OR SO. LARGE HAIL AND LOCALIZED DMGG WIND GUSTS APPEAR TO BE THE PRIMARY IMMEDIATE THREAT. THE POTENTIAL FOR A TORNADO IS NOT OUT OF THE QUESTION GIVEN E-SELY FLOW IN PLACE ACROSS SERN MT...AS BLX VWP SAMPLED WEAK BUT VEERING LOW-LEVEL FLOW PRIOR TO TSTM OCCURRENCE. OTHERWISE...SVR THREAT INTO THE LATE AFTERNOON WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD EWD WITHIN SVR TSTM WATCH 249 AND REMAIN HIGHEST WHERE THE AIR MASS REMAINS UNPERTURBED. ..ROGERS.. 06/13/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT ACROSS PARTS OF ERN MT INTO WRN ND APPEARS TO BE INCREASING...AND WW ISSUANCE IS BECOMING MORE LIKELY IN THE SHORT TERM.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: FORECAST REASONING PROVIDED IN PREVIOUSLY ISSUED MCD 895 FOR THIS REGION REMAINS GENERALLY UNCHANGED. RECENT RADAR AND SATELLITE TRENDS SUGGEST SUFFICIENT DESTABILIZATION HAS OCCURRED ACROSS WRN ND TO SUPPORT VIGOROUS THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT. 21Z RAP MESOANALYSIS AND SFC OBSERVATIONS SHOW A NARROW CORRIDOR OF INSTABILITY EXTENDING FROM ERN MT INTO WRN ND. BROAD LARGE-SCALE ASCENT IS INCREASING ACROSS THIS REGION AS AN UPPER TROUGH TO THE W APPROACHES. IN ADDITION...LATEST SHORT-TERM CAM GUIDANCE...INCLUDING THE PARALLEL HRRR...SUGGEST A THREAT FOR DISCRETE CONVECTION WILL EXTEND INTO PARTS OF WRN ND THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WOULD BE THE MAIN THREATS WITH THESE THUNDERSTORMS. GIVEN THESE TRENDS...SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH ISSUANCE IS BECOMING MORE LIKELY IN THE SHORT TERM.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SVR RISK MAY ACCOMPANY CONVECTION SPREADING ACROSS PARTS OF THE REGION THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS. WW ISSUANCE IS PRESENTLY UNLIKELY...THOUGH CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED. IF A MORE ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE SYSTEM WITH SVR POTENTIAL WERE TO DEVELOP...WW ISSUANCE PROBABILITIES COULD INCREASE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE LOOPS AND SFC OBSERVATIONS IMPLY HIGH-BASED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT ARISING FROM THE DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER ACROSS PARTS OF SERN NM -- WHERE SFC TEMPERATURES HAVE REACHED THE UPPER 90S TO NEAR 100F. WATER VAPOR LOOPS SUGGEST THAT LARGE-SCALE ASCENT IS MINIMAL ACROSS THESE AREAS...THOUGH OROGRAPHIC LIFT COMBINED WITH DEEP BOUNDARY-LAYER CIRCULATIONS MAY RESULT IN A FEW SUSTAINED CONVECTIVE ELEMENTS SPREADING EWD/SEWD INTO THE EVENING HOURS. AS THIS ACTIVITY SPREADS ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE LOWER ELEVATIONS OF W TX...IT WILL ENCOUNTER AN INCREASINGLY MOIST AND UNSTABLE AIR MASS ON THE MODIFYING/COOLER SIDE OF AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ANALYZED NW/SE THROUGH THE TX S PLAINS AND VICINITY. WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 60S TO LOWER 70S...MLCAPE OF 2000-4000 J/KG AMIDST 25-35 KT OF DEEP SHEAR MAY FACILITATE A FEW INTENSE UPDRAFTS WITH ISOLATED SVR WIND/HAIL. PRESENT INDICATIONS ARE THAT THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD REMAIN ISOLATED. HOWEVER...IF UPSCALE GROWTH OF ONE OR MORE CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS WERE TO YIELD A MORE WIDESPREAD SVR RISK...WW ISSUANCE MAY NEED TO BE CONSIDERED LATER.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SVR RISK CONTINUES ACROSS WW 250.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS AND A FEW SUPERCELLS CONTINUE TRACKING ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE CNTRL/SRN HIGH PLAINS. THE CONVECTIVELY UNPERTURBED AIR MASS REMAINS MODERATELY TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE...AS SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE MIDDLE 50S TO MIDDLE 60S ARE SAMPLED ACROSS THE REGION -- BENEATH STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. NOTABLE VERTICALLY-VEERING-FLOW PROFILES IN THE LOWEST 3 KM AGL SAMPLED BY AREA VWPS...COUPLED WITH 40-60 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR...SUGGEST THAT ORGANIZED CONVECTIVE MODES/POSSIBLE SUPERCELLS WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD EWD/SEWD DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. SUPERCELLS NEAR/E OF THE FRONT RANGE FROM PUEBLO TO CASTLE ROCK IN CO MAY HAVE THE GREATEST POTENTIAL TO PRODUCE SVR HAIL AND PERHAPS A COUPLE OF TORNADOES -- GIVEN THE ELY SFC WIND COMPONENT AND AMPLE AFOREMENTIONED LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE BACKED UP TO THE FRONT RANGE. OTHER CLUSTERS OF SVR TSTMS FROM SERN CO TO NERN NM AND THE WRN TX PANHANDLE WILL SPREAD EWD/SEWD WITH A RISK FOR SVR WIND/HAIL AND PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO. ..COHEN.. 06/13/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SIGNIFICANT SVR RISK IS INCREASING IN PORTIONS OF OLDHAM...POTTER...AND RANDALL COUNTIES IN THE TX PANHANDLE. THIS INCLUDES AREAS NEAR/N OF AMARILLO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A RIGHT-MOVING SUPERCELL HAS BECOME ESTABLISHED NW OF AMARILLO FOLLOWING MULTIPLE STORM SPLITS. THIS STORM WILL LIKELY RESIDE WITHIN A CORRIDOR OF VERY STRONG INSTABILITY ASSOCIATED WITH MIDDLE 60S DEWPOINTS IN PROXIMITY TO A DIFFUSE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...WHILE THE CELL MOVES EWD/ESEWD. THE AMA VWP SAMPLES AROUND 35 KT OF DEEP SHEAR WITH A VEERING WIND PROFILE IN THE LOWEST 3 KM THAT MAY SUPPORT A MAINTAINED SUPERCELL STRUCTURE -- PERHAPS INTO THE AMARILLO AREA OR TO ITS NORTH. THE RISK FOR SIGNIFICANT SVR HAIL -- TWO-INCH HAIL OR LARGER -- AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO MAY ACCOMPANY THIS ACTIVITY. ..COHEN.. 06/13/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONVECTION SPREADING EWD/SEWD THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS WILL POSE A RISK FOR SVR HAIL/WIND...ALONG WITH A COUPLE OF TORNADOES. A NEW TORNADO WATCH WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ONGOING SUPERCELLS AND CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS WILL CONTINUE SPREADING EWD/SEWD AMIDST AMPLE LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE THAT IS SUPPORTING MLCAPE AROUND 2000-4500 J/KG. THIS ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A RISK FOR SVR HAIL/WIND...WITH BACKED SFC WINDS SUPPORTING SUFFICIENT LOW-LEVEL SRH FOR SOME TORNADO RISK GIVEN THE LARGE DEGREE OF BUOYANCY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SVR RISK IS INCREASING E OF WW 250...LIKELY NECESSITATING THE ISSUANCE OF A SVR TSTM WATCH DOWNSTREAM.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FORWARD-PROPAGATING CONVECTIVE CLUSTER WILL CONTINUE SPREADING EWD/SEWD INTO/ACROSS PARTS OF SWRN KS. WITH MOIST/UNSTABLE INFLOW CHARACTERIZED BY 1000-2500 J/KG OF MLCAPE AMIDST 35-50 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR...SVR WIND/HAIL WILL LIKELY ACCOMPANY THIS ACTIVITY THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS PARTS OF WW 249 AND 251. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS REMAIN THE PRIMARY RISKS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ONGOING LINE OF CONVECTION ACROSS WRN SD WITH A HISTORY OF OBSERVED WIND GUSTS AOA 50 KT IS MOVING EWD AROUND 30-35 KT...AND IT WILL CONTINUE TO POSE MAINLY A DAMAGING WIND THREAT IN THE SHORT TERM. THIS ACTIVITY WILL LIKELY STRUGGLE TO MAINTAIN INTENSITY AS IT MOVES EWD INTO CNTRL SD GIVEN THAT A MUCH LESS UNSTABLE AIRMASS IS PRESENT THERE. ADDITIONAL CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT IS OCCURRING IN ERN WY WITH UPSLOPE ELY FLOW CONTINUING ALONG THE HIGHER TERRAIN...AND THE SEVERE THREAT ACROSS WRN PORTIONS OF WW 249 IN WY CONTINUES. ONGOING STRONG TO SEVERE CONVECTION IN NERN CO MAY EVENTUALLY GROW UPSCALE INTO ONE OR MORE BOWING LINE SEGMENTS AS IT SPREADS NEWD INTO PARTS OF WRN NEB...POSING MAINLY A DAMAGING WIND THREAT. THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS ERN MT AND WRN ND HAVE STRUGGLED TO BECOME SEVERE SO FAR...PROBABLY DUE TO LIMITED INSTABILITY WITH NWD EXTENT. REGARDLESS...RECENT RADAR TRENDS ACROSS THIS REGION SUGGEST HAIL APPROACHING SEVERE LEVELS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE FOR THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS ACROSS WW 251. ..GLEASON.. 06/14/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE PRIMARY SVR RISK IS BECOMING CONFINED TO NRN PARTS OF WW 250 -- ACROSS PORTIONS OF NERN CO...NWRN KS...AND FAR SWRN NEB. WW 250 IS PRESENTLY SCHEDULED TO EXPIRE AT 03Z...AND ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ANTECEDENT CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING RELATED TO THE UPSCALE GROWTH OF AN MCS NOW CROSSING PARTS OF SWRN KS AND THE OK/TX PANHANDLES...AND VEERED SFC FLOW OFF THE NM/SRN CO ROCKIES /SUPPORTING INFLUXES OF DRIER AND LESS UNSTABLE AIR/...ARE YIELDING DIMINISHED SVR POTENTIAL GENERALLY S OF A LINE FROM JUST N OF COLORADO SPRINGS CO TO GOODLAND KS. TO THE N OF THIS LINE...WHERE FORCING FOR ASCENT IS STRONGER E OF A MIGRATORY MID-LEVEL TROUGH...AND MODEST BUOYANCY LINGERS AMIDST 35-40 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR...ISOLATED SVR WIND/HAIL WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. HOWEVER...WITH NOCTURNAL COOLING...THE OVERALL SVR RISK SHOULD BECOME INCREASINGLY MARGINAL/ISOLATED BY 03Z. ..COHEN.. 06/14/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SVR RISK -- INCLUDING THE POTENTIAL FOR A COUPLE OF TORNADOES -- CONTINUES ACROSS WW 252.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A CLUSTER OF SUPERCELLS IN PORTIONS OF THE CNTRL TX PANHANDLE WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A RISK FOR SVR HAIL AND WIND WHILE SPREADING EWD/ESEWD. RECENT VWP DATA AT AMARILLO INDICATE A NOTABLE INCREASE IN LOW-LEVEL SRH...NOW AROUND 250 M2/S2 IN THE 0-1-KM LAYER. THIS INCREASE IN SRH IS COINCIDENT WITH THE WSWWD PROGRESSION OF COOLER/MOISTER AIR FEATURING STRONGER/MORE BACKED SFC WINDS. DESPITE THE SWD PROGRESSION OF AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ACROSS PARTS OF THE TX PANHANDLE...THE MESO-GAMMA-SCALE CIRCULATION ATTENDANT TO A LEAD SUPERCELL IN POTTER COUNTY WAS ABLE TO INGEST THE BOUNDARY IN SUFFICIENT PROXIMITY TO THE SUPERCELL IN SUPPORT OF A STRONG LOW-LEVEL CIRCULATION. THIS SUGGESTS SOME TORNADO POTENTIAL CONTINUING...ESPECIALLY WITH CYCLIC SUPERCELLS ADVANCING FROM ERN POTTER COUNTY INTO CARSON COUNTY -- WHICH WILL HAVE THE GREATEST POTENTIAL FOR INGESTING SFC-BASED EFFECTIVE-INFLOW LAYERS. ELSEWHERE...THE SRN FLANK OF A FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS THAT PRODUCED A 52-KT GUST AT LIBERAL KS WILL CROSS NRN PARTS OF THE TX PANHANDLE AND THE OK PANHANDLE...WITH A CONTINUED RISK OF SVR WIND GUSTS. ..COHEN.. 06/14/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MAINLY A DAMAGING WIND THREAT COULD CONTINUE BEYOND THE SCHEDULED 02Z EXPIRATION OF WW 249 ACROSS PARTS OF S-CNTRL SD INTO WRN NEB. A LOCAL EXTENSION IN TIME MAY BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ONGOING CLUSTER OF STRONG TO SEVERE CONVECTION CONTINUES ACROSS PART OF S-CNTRL SD INTO CHERRY COUNTY NEB AS OF 0130Z. LATEST RAP MESOANALYSIS AND SFC OBSERVATIONS SHOW A CORRIDOR OF INSTABILITY CHARACTERIZED BY MLCAPE OF 1000-1500 J/KG DOWNSTREAM OF THIS ACTIVITY...WHICH SHOULD SUPPORT THE MAINTENANCE OF THIS CLUSTER FOR AT LEAST THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS AS IT MOVES ESEWD WITH TIME. MID-LEVEL FLOW IS BEGINNING TO STRENGTHEN ACROSS THE MCD AREA AS THE UPPER TROUGH OVER THE GREAT BASIN/ROCKIES MOVES EWD...AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR VALUES OF 35-45 KT MAY ALLOW THE CONVECTION ACROSS FAR NERN CO INTO THE NEB PANHANDLE TO BECOME ORGANIZED AND ALSO POSE A DAMAGING WIND RISK FOR THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS AS IT MOVES EWD ACROSS WRN NEB. WITH WW 249 SCHEDULED TO EXPIRE AT 02Z...A LOCAL EXTENSION IN TIME ACROSS THE MCD AREA MAY BE NEEDED TO ADDRESS THE ONGOING DAMAGING WIND THREAT. ..GLEASON.. 06/14/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN MCS CROSSING PARTS OF SWRN KS...THE ERN OK PANHANDLE...AND THE NERN TX PANHANDLE WILL MOVE INTO/ACROSS WRN SECTIONS OF THE BODY OF OKLAHOMA IN THE NEXT FEW HOURS. A RISK FOR SVR WIND GUSTS WILL CONTINUE TO ACCOMPANY THIS ACTIVITY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A MEASURED SVR WIND GUST OF 52 KT WAS REPORTED WITH THE FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS AS IT CROSSED LIBERAL KANSAS EARLIER. AS THE LEADING CONVECTIVE LINE PROGRESSES EWD...IT WILL CONTINUE TO ENCOUNTER WARM/MOIST INFLOW...WITH A LOWEST-100-MB MEAN MIXING RATIO AROUND 15.5 G/KG SAMPLED BY THE 00Z OUN RAOB. VNX VWP DATA INDICATE SLIGHTLY STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL SLYS IN THE LAST COUPLE OF HOURS...THAT WILL LIKELY FACILITATE SOME SWD PROPAGATION OF THE MCS. THIS SHOULD FOSTER NET MCS MOTION ON MORE OF A ESEWD/SEWD TRACK ACROSS AS IT ENTERS THE BODY OF OKLAHOMA...WHERE GPS DATA INDICATES IT WILL ENCOUNTER INCREASING PW. THIS SHOULD SUPPORT CONTINUED MCS MAINTENANCE WITH A RISK FOR SVR WIND GUSTS CONTINUING. THE SVR RISK WILL DIMINISH TO NIL BEHIND THE LINE OF TSTMS. ..COHEN.. 06/14/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS THAT DEVELOPED OVER THE HIGH PLAINS WILL BE SPREADING ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS. WHILE A FEW STRONG TSTMS MAY LINGER...WITH GUSTY WINDS AND/OR SMALL HAIL...THE SVR RISK SHOULD BE MINIMAL...AND WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CLUSTERS OF TSTMS FROM SWRN KS TO NWRN OK AND THE TX PANHANDLE HAVE LARGELY ORGANIZED INTO LINEAR MODES. THE LONGER-DURATION MCS OVER NRN PARTS OF THIS AREA IS NOW BEYOND ITS MATURE PHASE AND IS DECAYING WITH A LEADING EDGE FROM COMANCHE COUNTY KS TO NEAR ELLIS COUNTY OK. INTENSE TSTMS CONTINUE FROM A MORE RECENTLY ORGANIZED MCS IN THE TX PANHANDLE. ALL OF THIS ACTIVITY WILL BE SPREADING E/SE OF WWS 252/253 INTO THE DISCUSSION AREA DURING THE OVERNIGHT HOURS. A FEW STRONG STORMS WITH LOCALLY GUSTY WINDS/SMALL HAIL MAY SPREAD E/SE OF WWS 252/253...ESPECIALLY WITH ACTIVITY EVENTUALLY MOVING E OF THE E-CNTRL/SERN TX PANHANDLE INTO W-CNTRL OK. REGARDLESS...RECENT SFC COOLING AND RELATED GAINS IN NOCTURNAL INHIBITION...COMBINED WITH THESE SYSTEMS BECOMING INCREASINGLY REMOVED FROM STRONGER DEEP SHEAR WHILE LOW-LEVEL FLOW REMAINS ONLY MODEST...SHOULD RESULT IN THE DECAY OF THESE SYSTEMS DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. SFC OBSERVATIONS INCLUDING OK MESONET OBS SUGGEST THAT GUSTS ACCOMPANYING THE NWRN OK/SWRN KS PORTION OF THIS ACTIVITY ARE LIKELY SUB-SEVERE...AS THE LEADING GUST FRONT HAS ADVANCED WELL AHEAD OF PARENT CONVECTION. AS SUCH...THE SVR RISK IS EXPECTED TO BE MINIMAL E OF WWS 252/253.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SVR RISK IS DIMINISHING IN REMAINING-VALID PORTIONS OF WW 253. NO ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE IS ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LEADING EDGE OF A WEAKENING MCS IS MOVING THROUGH PARTS OF SRN KS AND NWRN OK. RECENT SFC OBSERVATIONS SUGGEST THAT WIND GUSTS ARE LIKELY SUB-SEVERE...AS INFLOW NOCTURNALLY STABILIZES. FURTHERMORE...AS THIS SYSTEM CONTINUES TO DEPART A ZONE OF STRONGER DEEP SHEAR...IT WILL CONTINUE TO WEAKEN. AN MCS THAT HAS DEVELOPED IN THE CNTRL TX PANHANDLE WILL SPREAD INTO FAR W-CNTRL OK IN THE NEXT FEW HOURS...AND COULD BE ACCOMPANIED BY LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS. HOWEVER...THIS ACTIVITY WILL ALSO CONTINUE WEAKENING...WHILE LOW-LEVEL FLOW REMAINS ONLY MODEST. ..COHEN.. 06/14/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE LEADING EDGE OF AN MCS WILL CONTINUE TO ADVANCE EWD/SEWD ACROSS PARTS OF THE E-CNTRL/SERN TX PANHANDLE. AN ISOLATED SVR RISK MAY CONTINUE TO ACCOMPANY THIS ACTIVITY IN THE SHORT-TERM. THE SVR RISK WILL DECREASE TO NIL IN ITS WAKE...AND ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LEADING CONVECTIVE LINE ACCOMPANYING AN MCS FROM HEMPHILL COUNTY TO ARMSTRONG COUNTY WILL CONTINUE MOVING EWD/SEWD. THE AIR MASS AHEAD OF THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD REMAIN SUFFICIENTLY UNSTABLE IN THE SHORT-TERM FOR AN ISOLATED/MARGINAL SVR WIND/HAIL RISK. HOWEVER...AS RELATED OUTFLOW CONTINUES TO SURGE AHEAD OF PARENT CONVECTION...AND NOCTURNAL STABILIZATION OF INFLOW OCCURS AMIDST WEAK LOW-LEVEL FLOW...THE SVR RISK WILL CONTINUE TO DIMINISH. ..COHEN.. 06/14/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS SPREADING ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE CNTRL GREAT PLAINS DURING THE OVERNIGHT HOURS MAY BE STRONG ON A LOCALIZED BASIS. AN ISOLATED MARGINALLY SVR TSTM OR TWO MAY OCCUR...ALTHOUGH WW ISSUANCE IS UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: FORCING FOR ASCENT E OF A MID-LEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER PARTS OF CO/WY PER WATER VAPOR LOOPS...AND ASCENT ON THE PERIPHERY OF ALREADY-ESTABLISHED COLD POOLS...ARE FOSTERING BANDS AND CLUSTERS OF CONVECTION WITHIN A CORRIDOR FROM N-CNTRL NEB SWWD INTO NERN CO. THIS ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE SPREADING SEWD/EWD DURING THE OVERNIGHT HOURS. GIVEN AROUND 25-40 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR...AND SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE MIDDLE 50S IN NERN CO TO THE LOWER/MIDDLE 60S ELSEWHERE SUPPORTING AROUND 500-1250 J/KG OF MLCAPE...A FEW STRONG TSTMS WITH GUSTY WINDS/SMALL HAIL MAY ACCOMPANY THIS ACTIVITY. AN ISOLATED MARGINALLY SVR TSTM OR TWO CANNOT BE RULED OUT...PARTICULARLY FROM NERN CO INTO NWRN KS AND SWRN NEB...WHERE UPDRAFTS ARE SOMEWHAT MORE SEPARATED. REGARDLESS...GIVEN ONLY MODEST INCREASES IN THE STRENGTH OF AN LLJ...GIVEN THE LACK OF STRONGER BUOYANCY/SHEAR...AND GIVEN NOCTURNAL INCREASES IN MLCINH...A MORE SUBSTANTIAL SVR RISK IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
